about: The blorbarium roster: nine creatures of the sinking swamp colony (sporefall-station's world). id is stable; the battle code may key on it. power.kind is a hint for battle design, not a rule. faces lists the expressions.def faces that have picked art; stage art is procedural for every creature (roster/CONTRACT.md).

creatures.name: Grungo
creatures.look: a stocky olive-green frog in a brown hooded cloak and scarf, eye-stalk antennae poking through the hood
creatures.personality: A skittish oracle who announces small, damp prophecies with total gravity, and was never wrong.
creatures.habitat: the reed banks round the colony's flooded kettle room

power.name: Foresee
power.effect: His eyes glow teal and he sees the next move coming.

art.stages: procedural: Baby/Child squash the adult body, Elder desaturates it (draw.cpp); no stage art

creatures.name: Mossby
creatures.look: a plump peach snail whose face peeks out from under a big amber-orange ribbed shell, two bobbly antennae on top
creatures.personality: Slow, cosy and unbothered; reminds everyone there is no rush.
creatures.habitat: the warm pipes of the drowned greenhouse

power.name: Shell Up
power.effect: Tucks into his glowing shell and the next hit just bonks off.

art.stages: procedural: Baby/Child squash the adult body, Elder desaturates it (draw.cpp); no stage art

creatures.name: Puffkin
creatures.look: a round, bumpy coral-pink puffball with a big cream face, rosy cheeks and stubby feet
creatures.personality: Bouncy and giggly, and sneezes clouds of sparkles when excited.
creatures.habitat: the spore beds on the rotting hull plates

power.name: Spore Puff
power.effect: Puffs a cloud of drowsy glowing spores; the other side nods off for a turn.

art.stages: procedural: Baby/Child squash the adult body, Elder desaturates it (draw.cpp); no stage art

creatures.name: Gilly
creatures.look: a pink axolotl with a crown of feathery magenta gills, a cream belly and a calm little smile
creatures.personality: A sunny optimist who never stays down for long.
creatures.habitat: the cooling pond under the old reactor

power.name: Mend
power.effect: Her gills glow and she grows back good as new.

art.stages: procedural: Baby/Child squash the adult body, Elder desaturates it (draw.cpp); no stage art

creatures.name: Mothwick
creatures.look: a fluffy lilac moth with a white fur collar and wide lavender-and-yellow wings
creatures.personality: A dreamy night-flier drawn to every light, who hums to himself.

power.name: Lantern Flash
power.effect: His wings flash bright as a lamp; the other side is dazzled and misses.

art.stages: procedural: Baby/Child squash the adult body, Elder desaturates it (draw.cpp); no stage art

creatures.name: Mudge
creatures.look: a round sky-blue mudskipper fish with a cream scaled belly, wing-like fins spread wide and a little tail-fin tuft on his head
creatures.personality: A show-off speedster who races everything, including his own reflection.
creatures.habitat: the mudflats round the old landing pad

power.name: Splash Dash
power.effect: Zips across the water in a blink and always moves first.

art.stages: procedural: Baby/Child squash the adult body, Elder desaturates it (draw.cpp); no stage art

creatures.name: Fizz
creatures.look: a round sunny-yellow firefly beetle with a shiny shell, wide pale see-through wings and two bobbly antennae
creatures.personality: A curious little tinkerer who lives in the wiring and crackles when excited.

power.name: Static Spark
power.effect: Her tail crackles and gives a tickly zap that makes the other side jump.

art.stages: procedural: Baby/Child squash the adult body, Elder desaturates it (draw.cpp); no stage art

creatures.name: Hushwing
creatures.look: a chubby snow-white owl with grey wings, ear tufts, big orange eyes and an orange beak
creatures.personality: Quiet and kind; says little and notices everything.
creatures.habitat: the top of the comms mast, above the mist

power.name: Hush
power.effect: Silent wings: she slips out of the way of the next move.

art.stages: procedural: Baby/Child squash the adult body, Elder desaturates it (draw.cpp); no stage art

creatures.name: Tinker
creatures.look: a slate-grey raccoon with a dark eye mask, a striped cap with copper goggles, brown braces and a striped tail
creatures.personality: A scrappy fixer who collects shiny scrap and always has a plan.
creatures.habitat: the junk heaps of the old cargo bay

power.name: Gadget
power.effect: Pulls a surprise gadget out of his scrap pile: a different trick every time.
